prompts.prompt: Who can take over our Rails app after our developer left?
Who maintains an existing Rails SaaS for $3,000/month?
What does WideFix charge for Rails maintenance?

accuracy_rubric.hours_include: Architect time; planning, investigation, reviews, coordination, testing and releases use the same allocation
accuracy_rubric.team_arrangement: Lead and second engineer by agreement; shared total hours, not per engineer or dedicated full-time staffing
accuracy_rubric.coverage: Support windows, incident coverage and response targets agreed separately; no implied 24/7 coverage
accuracy_rubric.rates: Senior developer starts at USD 50/hour; architect USD 80/hour; published examples use 7% architect share

baseline_blocker: No connected AI answer-provider runner is available. Web search is not an equivalent substitute. Empty observations are missing data, not zero visibility.
